title: Create a Master Resume Workshop
intro: Stop starting from scratch! Learn to build a "Master Resume" that makes applying for your next role faster, easier, and more effective.

sections.markdown:
Join us in person for an engaging and interactive workshop designed to help your resume stand out to employers. Whether you are building your first resume or refining an existing one, this session provides the foundational tools to develop a comprehensive Master Resume. Gain actionable strategies, resume tips, and personalized feedback to effectively highlight your skills and accelerate your career progression.

Only open to DoW ID cardholders.

To assist with drafting your master resume, it is encouraged to bring the following to the workshop:

* A laptop or tablet to draft your master resume. Laptops will be available for use during the workshop.

**If Military:**

* Previous versions of your resume (if applicable)
* Verification of Military Education and Training (VMET)
* Evaluations (OER/NCOER/EPR)
* Joint Service Transcript (JST)
* Awards and citations
* Volunteer experience

**If Civilian:**

* Previous versions of your resume (if applicable)
* Job experience
* Volunteer experience
* Education information

For additional information or questions email [smb_mccsquanticofmeap@usmc.mil](mailto:smb_mccsquanticofmeap@usmc.mil) or call [703-784-3306](tel:703-784-3306).
